conditions.condition_text: Identify the initial supply or demand zone on the higher timeframe using the last candle before the impulse.
The last candle before the impulse marks the zone where institutional buying or selling took place.
Zoom into a lower timeframe (e.g., 1H) to identify smaller supply or demand zones inside the initial higher timeframe zone.
Refining the zone to a smaller timeframe allows for a more precise entry and amplified risk-to-reward.
Select the 'extreme zone,' which is the zone furthest from price within the current leg of price movement.
The extreme zone is chosen because it offers the best risk-reward and is considered the safest entry point.
Wait for the lower timeframe structure to change in agreement with the larger trend direction (Standard Confirmation).
Standard confirmation confirms that the zone has enough strength to reshape the trend.
Enter a buy limit order at the refined zone (extreme zone) upon confirmation of a structural shift.
Entering at the refined zone captures the wick and secures a sniper entry.
A demand zone is an area of consolidation before a strong upward move.
Zooming into a lower timeframe allows for the identification of smaller zones inside the initial zone.
The extreme zone is the furthest zone from price in the leg of price movement.
Wait for the lower timeframe structure to change in agreement with the larger trend direction.
The stop loss is placed structurally below the zone for long entries.
The target is set up into the structural high of the initial zone.
